data.one_liner: Dart async extensions for Future, FutureOr, and performance improvements.
data.what_it_does: Provides extensions and utility functions for Future and FutureOr to optimize synchronous and asynchronous code paths, reduce GC overhead, and add arithmetic operators and try-catch-finally chains for async blocks.
use_when: You want to interoperate between sync and async code without unnecessary Future allocations
You need arithmetic operators directly on Future and FutureOr instances
You want to handle execution chains using utility functions like asyncTry
avoid_when: You prefer sticking strictly to standard library async/await primitives without third-party extension methods
strengths: Improves performance and reduces GC overhead for mixed sync/async computations
Comprehensive helper methods for FutureOr manipulation and error handling
weaknesses: Relies on custom extension paradigms instead of native language primitives

alternatives.name: async
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides official Dart asynchronous utilities and collection extensions from the core team.
